This topic is part of the CCEA A-Level Music specification.

Unit AS 3: Responding to Music appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Unit AS 3: Responding to Music in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Unit AS 3: Responding to Music.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
